reviews.title: Shouldn’t have been released this early and way too many ads
reviews.text:
I hardly ever write a review ever. So I’m just going to be honest. I’ve played games that had frequent ads but I literally could not play the game for a solid 60 seconds without an ad break. Extremely annoying. Second thing, I’m lucky I didn’t make any purchases (not like I ever would) because at the beach chapter, I am stuck at an infinite loop. The game is very underdeveloped and glitchy, the graphics are terrible, and there is nothing good about anything you do. Useless game. 

Definitely has potential, but needs to be developed more. Take this off the App Store and Re-release it when it’s more complete.
